Team spirit is shining bright at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Soft paws, steady hands, and clear updates are keeping things moving for travelers and crew alike.

Pet Travel Roundup
The senior coordinator and safety coordinator have been busy smoothing out care plans, checking comfort notes, and helping crews stay ready. <<FACT F020>> Travelers can expect kinder guidance, calmer handoffs, and a little less stress all around. We are grateful for the careful work that keeps every companion feeling supported.

Room is also staying mindful on the back end. <<FACT F029>> Thanks for the patience, and for trusting us to keep each journey as smooth as possible.
